parameters.query: SELECT chat_id, nama, role FROM ide09.allowed_chats WHERE chat_id = $1;
INSERT INTO ide09.audit_log (chat_id, event, detail) VALUES ($1, 'unauthorized_confirmation_attempt', jsonb_build_object('request_id', $2::text, 'waktu', now())) RETURNING id;
SELECT id, request_id, chat_id, tool, args, ringkasan, status FROM ide09.pending_actions WHERE request_id = $1 AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY id ASC;

WITH decision_target AS (
  SELECT id, request_id, chat_id, tool, args, ringkasan
  FROM ide09.pending_actions
  WHERE request_id = $1 AND status = 'pending'
),
ins_faults AS (
  INSERT INTO ide09.equipment_faults (asset_tag, line_area, deskripsi, severity, maintenance_type, downtime_mins, tenggat)
  SELECT
    COALESCE(args->>'asset_tag', 'CONV-L2'),
    COALESCE(args->>'line_area', 'Rolling Mill Line 2'),
    COALESCE(args->>'deskripsi', ringkasan),
    COALESCE(args->>'severity', 'MEDIUM'),
    COALESCE(args->>'maintenance_type', 'corrective'),
    COALESCE((args->>'downtime_mins')::integer, 0),
    COALESCE((args->>'tenggat')::date, CURRENT_DATE + 2)
  FROM decision_target WHERE $2 = 'confirm' AND tool = 'lapor_fault'
  RETURNING id
),
ins_expenses AS (
  INSERT INTO ide09.sparepart_expenses (asset_tag, part_name, jumlah, kategori, vendor, tanggal, catatan, sumber)
  SELECT
    COALESCE(args->>'asset_tag', 'PLANT-EQUIP'),
    COALESCE(args->>'part_name', 'Suku Cadang'),
    COALESCE((args->>'jumlah')::integer, 0),
    COALESCE(args->>'kategori', 'mekanik'),
    COALESCE(args->>'vendor', 'Mitra Pabrik'),
    COALESCE((args->>'tanggal')::date, CURRENT_DATE),
    COALESCE(args->>'catatan', ringkasan),
    'agent'
  FROM decision_target WHERE $2 = 'confirm' AND tool = 'catat_sparepart'
  RETURNING id
),
ins_reminders AS (
  INSERT INTO ide09.inspection_reminders (chat_id, asset_tag, teks, waktu, status)
  SELECT
    chat_id,
    COALESCE(args->>'asset_tag', 'PLANT-EQUIP'),
    COALESCE(args->>'teks', ringkasan),
    COALESCE((args->>'waktu')::timestamptz, now() + interval '1 day'),
    'aktif'
  FROM decision_target WHERE $2 = 'confirm' AND tool = 'buat_inspeksi'
  RETURNING id
),
upd_faults AS (
  UPDATE ide09.equipment_faults ef
  SET status = 'selesai'
  FROM decision_target dt
  WHERE $2 = 'confirm' AND dt.tool = 'tutup_fault' AND ef.id = (dt.args->>'fault_id')::integer
  RETURNING ef.id
),
upd_pending AS (
  UPDATE ide09.pending_actions
  SET status = CASE WHEN $2 = 'confirm' THEN 'confirmed' ELSE 'cancelled' END,
      diputuskan_at = now()
  WHERE request_id = $1 AND status = 'pending'
  RETURNING id, tool, ringkasan
),
audit AS (
  INSERT INTO ide09.audit_log (chat_id, event, detail)
  VALUES (
    $3,
    CASE WHEN $2 = 'confirm' THEN 'action_confirmed' ELSE 'action_cancelled' END,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'request_id', $1::text,
      'decision', $2::text,
      'actions_affected', (SELECT count(*) FROM upd_pending),
      'timestamp', now()
    )
  )
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT count(*) as affected_count FROM upd_pending;
